name: Smear entrance / exit
visual_intent: Fast kinetic arrival with directional blur and stretch that settles crisp.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Entrance comes from this side; with exit:true the target leaves toward it

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Travel in --u units (1% of the short side)

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Seconds; keep under 0.6 or the blur reads as soft focus

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: On a beat or cut; pairs with hard cuts in word-beats sequences

code_snippet.javascript:
Studio.fx.smear(tl, '#word', 2.0, { side: 'left', duration: 0.4 });
Studio.fx.smear(tl, '#word', 3.6, { side: 'right', exit: true, duration: 0.3 });

fallbacks: Plain push/slide with expo ease (no filter) if the render host shows filter cost or banding.

performance_characteristics.memory_impact: Low; blur cost scales with element area; estimate, not measured on the M2

validation_steps: On the M2: hyperframes render with --low-memory-mode and check render time and memory against a no-filter variant

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
